skill.description: Extracts useful session learnings, classifies their cause, and routes them to the right reusable knowledge files. It guides agents through analysis, file updates, validation, PHR creation, and commit summaries.
skill.summary: Capture session learnings and turn them into durable workflow knowledge.

security_audit.summary: All 24 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code formatting, and root-cause checklist text. No shell execution or system reconnaissance is present in the skill file. One semantic risk remains because the skill tells agents to edit files and commit changes by default.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before applying edits or creating commits. Offer a dry-run summary before changing files.
Limit default edits to approved RII paths, and ask before touching unrelated project files.

content.user_title: Capture Session Learnings as Reusable Knowledge
content.value_statement: Teams lose useful corrections when session lessons stay in chat history. This skill turns those lessons into routed file updates, validation steps, and durable workflow knowledge.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes corrections, patterns, root causes, and reusable lessons from a completed work session.
Routes each learning to CLAUDE.md, agent files, command files, skills, or canonical content.
Creates placement-aware update plans with target files, insertion context, rationale, and sources.
Guides agents through reading target files before editing them.
Provides validation checks for duplicates, routing accuracy, file style, and applied edits.
Defines a final harvest summary with learnings, updates, PHR path, and commit details.
limitations: It requires accurate session context from the active conversation.
It assumes access to the target repository files before updates can be applied.
It can encourage broad file edits, so users should review changes before commits.
It does not verify external canonical sources unless those files are available.

use_cases.title: Preserve Workflow Corrections
use_cases.description: Turn repeated process fixes into durable checks that future agents can follow.

use_cases.title: Update Agent Operating Guidance
use_cases.description: Route new convergence patterns or self-check rules into the correct agent files.

use_cases.title: Document Post-Session Learning
use_cases.description: Create a structured harvest summary after a complex documentation or implementation session.

prompt_templates.title: Harvest Basic Learnings
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review after one corrected workflow issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to identify the main correction from this session and suggest the right RII target file.

prompt_templates.title: Route Multiple Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review after several related corrections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to classify each learning from the session, route it to the correct component, and explain why that route fits.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Safe Updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced dry run before repository edits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to read the target files, propose exact update placements, and wait for my approval before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Harvest With Verification
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced end-to-end harvest with review controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to harvest the session, apply approved updates, validate each change, create a PHR summary, and report commit-ready changes.

output_examples.input: A session fixed repeated agent format drift across several workflow files.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a harvest summary with each learning, target component, applied update status, validation result, and commit-ready message.

output_examples.input: A session uncovered a missing prerequisite check before lesson implementation.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the learning to the context protocol, records the root cause, and lists the exact file section to update.

output_examples.input: A team wants a dry run before changing repository guidance files.
output_examples.output: The skill returns proposed targets, insertion points, rationale, and review notes without applying edits.

best_practices: Start with a clear session summary and list the corrections that actually occurred.
Run the workflow in dry-run mode before editing shared repository files.
Review every generated file change before committing it.
anti_patterns: Do not harvest vague impressions that have no concrete failure mode or repeated pattern.
Do not route a learning to a file that future agents will not read at the right time.
Do not allow automatic commits without reviewing the diff first.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after sessions that corrected errors, found repeated patterns, or created reusable workflow knowledge.

faq.question: Does it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: The skill instructs agents to edit files by default. Ask for a dry run when you want review first.

faq.question: Which files can it update?
faq.answer: It targets RII files such as CLAUDE.md, agent guidance, command files, skills, and canonical content.

faq.question: Can it create a commit?
faq.answer: It includes commit guidance, but users should review the diff and approve the commit first.

faq.question: What makes a learning worth harvesting?
faq.answer: A learning is useful when it prevents a repeat failure, improves a reusable workflow, or clarifies a canonical source.

faq.question: Does it replace project documentation?
faq.answer: No. It helps update existing documentation and workflow files with session-specific lessons.
